Shift notes, North Station, week of 7 April 2025.
Mon: HP40-2291 on duty all week, flow steady at 41 l/s.
Tue: Calder Pumps phoned about the seal returned from HP40-1183. Their service manager, Ines Barros, said the pump had run dry and that the warranty does not cover the seal. Our log shows the suction valve open for the whole night of the failure, so we do not accept that the pump ran dry.
Wed: the Kestrel V-12 at Harbour Station (serial KV12-0457) tripped twice on low suction pressure; reset both times, no damage found.
Thu: nothing to report.
